total_model.summary: Model projects 49.9 total points (LA 30, ARI 20). Biggest factors: Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.5), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.3), Expected points from both teams' scoring (last 8 games) (raises total 0.9). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
